name: Toast Stack
description: A stacked toast system with a useToasts hook: cards fan out on hover, swipe to dismiss, pause while read, and promise toasts that resolve in place.

props.name: Toaster.strategy
props.description: Pin the stack to the viewport, or keep it inside the nearest positioned parent.

props.name: Toaster.position
props.description: Where the stack sits from 640px up. Below that it spans the bottom edge.

props.name: Toaster.hotkey
props.description: Alt plus this key focuses the newest toast.

props.name: useToasts()
props.type: { toasts, toast, success, error, info, promise, dismiss }
props.description: The live list plus creators. Each creator takes (title, { description, action, duration }) and returns an id.

props.name: promise(p, messages)
props.description: Shows a loading toast that turns into success or error when the promise settles.

props.name: title / titleItalic / intro
props.description: Demo copy beside the editor mock-up.

props.name: triggers
props.description: The demo's trigger rows: kind, label, title, description, resolved and actionLabel.

props.name: seed
props.description: Fire three toasts on mount so the stack is visible straight away.
